maxBreaths.title: Deterministic closure safety ceiling
maxBreaths.description: Hard safety ceiling for internal transitions in one pulse. The Kernel still crosses at most one costly frontier, but may carry a longer chain of deterministic/free consequences in the same invocation instead of serializing them into repeated runs.

observation.title: Optional Fruit observation
observation.description: Machine-provided sensor snapshot. Metric-only churn is stored quietly; only decision-relevant truth changes create a Garden event and wake Flower.
